intro.h2: Tile work you notice in the details
paragraphs: Integrity Tile LLC handles bathroom remodeling in Titusville, Florida, with a focus on the tile: shower walls, recessed niches, mosaic floors and large-format floor tile. Paul is the name customers mention in every review, and the Google profile holds 62 photos of finished jobs.

Customers notice the small things. Ethan F. says his new bathroom looks stunning, down to the smallest finishes, and that Paul was easy to communicate with and genuinely invested in their vision. Rebecca N. was grateful for Paul's input when she just didn't know what to do, and says he did so much work in a week that she was amazed.

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: From guest baths to main bathrooms, Paul handles the remodel with the tile front and center. One guest bathroom shown here has a tub with sliding glass doors, white tile walls and a long niche lined with glass mosaic, plus a new white vanity.

image.alt: Tub and shower with sliding glass doors and a long glass mosaic niche

items.name: Tiled showers and niches
items.blurb: Walk-in showers are a specialty you can see in the photos: marble-look wall tile, pebble or hexagon mosaic floors, linear drains and built-in niches framed in black or gold trim. Each niche gives you a place for bottles without a hanging caddy.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with marble-look subway tile, pebble mosaic floor and a pebble-lined niche

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: Large-format porcelain floors run through hallways and bathrooms in Paul's photos, along with patterned hexagon tile and stone. Clean, straight grout lines and flat, even tile are what make a big floor look good, and they are what these photos show.

image.alt: Collage of tile work: large porcelain floors, hexagon mosaics, marble-look showers and gold-trimmed niches

items.name: Kitchen tile and backsplashes
items.blurb: Integrity Tile works in kitchens too. One Google review summary reads, had our kitchen redone by Paul with Integrity Tile and couldn't be happier. His project photos include a glass subway tile backsplash behind a double sink. Ask Paul about your kitchen.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a bright Florida kitchen with white shaker cabinets, light quartz countertops and a stainless double sink with a matte black faucet under a window, finished with a blue-green glass subway tile backsplash. Clean grout lines, soft natural daylight, a small potted plant, colors of white, warm gray and ocean blue. No people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Kitchen with white cabinets, quartz counters and a blue-green glass subway tile backsplash

items.title: Clean and organized
items.text: Hien L. describes Paul as very professional, helpful, organized and clean, and cleanliness is one of the topics customers mention most in the Google reviews.

items.title: Fair pricing, steady progress
items.text: Hien L. says his pricing is very reasonable and the job was done in a timely manner. Rebecca N. was amazed at how much work he did in a week.

about.text: Integrity Tile LLC is a bathroom remodeler based at 1851 Cashew Courtway in Titusville, Florida. Paul is the name in every review, and he replies to reviews personally, often by name, like the note thanking one family and promising to come back for more of Anthony's homemade meatballs. His photos show a wide range of tile: marble-look porcelain, hexagon and pebble mosaics, glass subway backsplashes, gold-trimmed niches and large polished floors. Customers say he is professional, knowledgeable, organized and clean, and that he gets a lot done in a short time.
about.owner_role: Does the work and answers reviews as the owner (last name not found)

items.name: Ethan F.
items.text: It’s rare to find a contractor who delivers both impeccable quality and top-notch customer service, but Paul does exactly that. Our new bathroom looks stunning, down to the smallest finishes. Throughout the project, he was incredibly considerate, easy to communicate with, and genuinely invested in bringing our vision to life. If you want an stress-free remodel with beautiful results, this is the person to hire.

items.name: Rebecca N.
items.text: Paul made us a beautiful guest bathroom. He's professional, knowledgeable, and does great work!!  I was grateful for his input when I just didn't know what to do. He did so much work  in a week. I'm amazed. We couldn't be happier. Thanks so much.

items.name: Hien L.
items.text: Paul did an amazing job. Will be using him again for my next bathroom job. He was very professional, helpful, organized, and clean. Got the job done in a timely manner. I can't say enough about him. His pricing is very reasonable.

service_area.text: Integrity Tile LLC is based at 1851 Cashew Courtway in Titusville, Florida, and Paul comes to your home to do the work. The Google listing does not name other towns, so if you live outside Titusville, call (321) 225-1849 or email integritytile321@gmail.com and ask whether your project is in his area before you plan your remodel. Photos of the space make that first conversation quicker.

items.q: Do you do kitchens as well as bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. Bathrooms are the main focus, but one review summary on Google reads, had our kitchen redone by Paul with Integrity Tile and couldn't be happier. Paul's photos also include a glass subway tile backsplash behind a kitchen sink. Ask about your kitchen when you call or email.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Call (321) 225-1849 or email integritytile321@gmail.com. Photos of your current bathroom, kitchen or floor help Paul understand the job. Customers describe his pricing as very reasonable, and every project is quoted for your space, so no prices are listed on this page.

items.q: I don't know what tile I want. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. Rebecca N. writes that she was grateful for Paul's input when she just didn't know what to do, and calls him professional and knowledgeable. His photos show many options, from marble-look porcelain to hexagon, pebble and glass mosaics, so bring your ideas or ask for his.

items.q: How long does a bathroom take?
items.a: Every bathroom is different, so ask Paul about your own timeline. Customers say the work moves along: Hien L. says the job was done in a timely manner, and Rebecca N. says Paul did so much work in a week on her guest bathroom that she was amazed.

Google lists Integrity Tile LLC as open 24 hours Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday. The quickest way to start is a call to (321) 225-1849 or an email to integritytile321@gmail.com, and Paul will get back to you about your project.

final_cta.h2: Ready for a bathroom that looks right down to the details?
final_cta.text: Call or email Paul for a quote on your bathroom, shower, floor or backsplash.
